crossRefs.note: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served…

translations.web: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
translations.bsb: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
translations.kjv: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
translations.asv: Depart from me, ye evil-doers, That I may keep the commandments of my God.
